columns.acclimated: whether the crew is acclimated to the theater the report time is expressed in
columns.longest_free_period_prior_7d: longest single period free from all duty in the 7 days before report, h:mm
columns.onboard_rest_facility: class of onboard rest facility fitted, or 'none'
columns.pilots_assigned: number of pilots assigned to the pairing
columns.prior_fdp_rolling_28d: flight duty period hours already accrued in the 28 days before report, h:mm
columns.prior_fdp_rolling_7d: flight duty period hours already accrued in the 7 days before report, h:mm
columns.prior_flight_rolling_28d: flight hours already accrued in the 28 days before report, h:mm
columns.release_local: scheduled release time, same clock; earlier than report_local means the pairing ends the next day
columns.report_local: scheduled report time, expressed in the local time of the theater the crew was last acclimated to
columns.rest_before_duty: rest actually given immediately before report, h:mm
columns.rest_opportunity_accommodation: what the crew member is given for that rest opportunity
columns.rest_opportunity_after_first_segment: whether the rest opportunity is scheduled only after the first segment has been flown
columns.rest_opportunity_end: end of that rest opportunity, or blank
columns.rest_opportunity_start: start of a scheduled rest opportunity inside the pairing, or blank

output_contract.binding_limit: one of limit_codes: the limit with the smallest margin, ties resolved in the order limit_codes is given in
output_contract.binding_margin_min: signed whole minutes: that smallest margin. The pairing complies with every limit exactly when this is not negative.
output_contract.fdp_margin_min: signed whole minutes: the applicable maximum flight duty period minus the scheduled flight duty period

regulatory_scope: Scheduled domestic and flag passenger operations of a US air carrier certificated under 14 CFR part 121, whose flightcrew members are subject to 14 CFR part 117. Every row is a SCHEDULED pairing taken from the published bid package; none is an as-flown record, and no unforeseen operational circumstance has arisen.
